results.title: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Anthropic back __usage_ai-training robots.txt opt-out token
results.description: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic have committed to honor a single robots.txt signal that lets a website state, in one place, that its content should not be used to train AI models. The mechanism is a new policy token, __usage_ai-training, described in an Internet-Draft titled "Machine-Readable Training Preference Signal" that was published on October 30, 2026 and authored by Kevin Kelley of Anthropic.
